binary_note: Reused the preceding baseline and tagged builds. Original and final kfunc modes use the identical enhanced binary; only the module and control script differ. SHA-256 identifies the exact artifacts.

method.topology: same-host isolated client -> LAN bridge -> router NAT -> PPPoE veth -> native Linux PPP AC -> server
method.fixed_rate: --fq-rate 1G with fq on both transmitting endpoint interfaces
method.offloads: new control script configures local GRO and peer TSO; benchmark only asserts values
method.cpu_note: busy CPU includes endpoints, router, AC and background activity over warmup plus measurement; four-CPU total percent = busy cores / 4 * 100. Not router-only CPU.
method.limits: same-host software topology, AC shares CPUs; full-rate P4 retransmits and VM steal are present; not physical NIC or ISP throughput
